description: The usual fix: look the key up at the top of payments.charge() (no lock).
Clumsier but correct: the same lookup copied into the webhook and the renewal job.
Copies the API's lookup into the webhook only; a restarted renewal run still charges twice.
Computes what is left from the refunds that succeeded, and keeps refunded_cents in step.

edits.new:
refunded = sum(r.amount_cents for r in svc.repo.refunds_for(charge_id) if r.status is RefundStatus.SUCCEEDED)
        remaining = charge.amount_cents - refunded

charge.refunded_cents = refunded + amount_cents
        svc.repo.save_charge(charge)
        svc.ledger.transfer("merchant", f"customer:{charge.customer_id}", amount_cents, memo=f"refund {refund.id}")
